meta.name: amazon-asin-lookup-api-skill
meta.description: This skill helps users extract structured product details from Amazon using a specific ASIN (Amazon Standard Identification Number). Use this skill when the user asks to get Amazon product details by ASIN, lookup Amazon product title and price using ASIN, extract Amazon product ratings and reviews count for a specific ASIN, check Amazon product availability and current price, get Amazon product description and features via ASIN, enrich product catalog with Amazon data using ASIN, monitor Amazon product price changes for specific ASINs, retrieve Amazon product brand and material information, fetch Amazon product images and specifications by ASIN, validate Amazon ASIN and get product metadata.

copy.tagline: 通过ASIN提取亚马逊商品详情
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要从亚马逊获取商品信息来运营店铺或做市场分析。
copy.tagline_en: Extract Amazon product details by ASIN
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need Amazon product data for store operations or market analysis.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的 ASIN（亚马逊标准识别码）查询并返回该商品的标题、价格、评分、品牌、描述等结构化信息。
howto.when: 当你要求查询某个亚马逊商品的详细信息，或提供 ASIN 码时触发。

say.text: 帮我查一下 ASIN 是 B07TS6R1SF 的商品信息。
say.note: 返回该商品的标题、价格、评分等数据。

say.text: 这个 ASIN 的当前价格和库存状态是什么？
say.note: 返回当前价格和可用性信息。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude can look up structured product details from Amazon using a provided ASIN, including title, price, ratings, brand, description, and more.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for Amazon product details or provide an ASIN.

say_en.text: Look up product info for ASIN B07TS6R1SF.
What is the current price and availability for this ASIN?
say_en.note: Returns current price and stock status.
